caseNameFull: Dan's City Used Cars, Inc., dba Dan's City Auto Body v. Pelkey

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. N. H. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1065.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
